defects.title: No real database connected
defects.description: All transaction, subscription, and health data is mock. Prisma schema exists but not migrated.
defects.remediation: Connect Supabase or Postgres, run prisma migrate dev

defects.title: Auth not enabled
defects.description: All API routes are public. No session validation.
defects.remediation: Add NextAuth middleware or Supabase RLS

defects.title: API routes not edge-runtime compatible
defects.description: Some routes may import Node-only modules incompatible with Cloudflare edge runtime.
defects.remediation: Audit imports, use fetch-only patterns for edge
